decision.title: The Top Ten Hits
tracklist: I Want You, I Need You, I Love You
Wear My Ring Around Your Neck
Can't Help Falling in Love with You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (38 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/2259509-Elvis-Presley-The-Top-Ten-Hits, https://www.discogs.com/release/2760744-Elvis-Presley-The-Top-Ten-Hits. 1987 RCA commemorative 2-LP/2-CD set (6383-1-R / 6383-2-R) of US Top 10 hits in chronological order; digitally remastered by Jack Adelman. 38-track sequence identical across Discogs US 2LP, Europe 2CD and Discogs master entries. International releases under the title 'The All Time Greatest Hits' use a slightly different tracklist (Blue Suede Shoes, King Creole, Love Letters, etc.) and are not this release.
